8722.summary: Justified before God by Christ's blood, believers show their faith before men by works, while those who make works their justification damn themselves.

8723.theme: Fear is a lack of faith
8723.title: In Every Thing Give Thanks
8723.summary: Giving thanks in all things, good or bad, and trusting God's will will change a believer's life more than anything short of salvation.

8755.title: Run the Race Looking unto Jesus
8755.summary: Believers must lay aside guilt, bitterness and the cares of this world to run the race, receiving God's chastening as a sign of His love.

8756.title: Make Straight Paths for Your Feet
8756.summary: Believers must be separate from the world, accept chastening, and avoid bitterness so their good report draws others to God's grace.

8757.title: Not Sinai but Mount Sion
8757.summary: Believers are not under the covenant of Sinai that brought death but come to the heavenly Sion of the new covenant, serving God with reverence.

8826.title: The Wisdom of God Against the Vexation of the World
8826.summary: The wisdom of this world brings despair, but the foolishness of the gospel gives rest, wisdom and joy to all who come to Christ.

8998.title: Zacharias Prophesies the Promise Fulfilled
8998.summary: Zacharias shows in the Spirit that all the prophets' promises to Abraham, Moses and David are fulfilled as John prepares the way of Christ.

8999.title: Mary was saved by faith alone
8999.summary: Luke records no immaculate conception; Mary was blessed and counted righteous by faith like every saint, so those who worship Mary miss God's grace.

9015.title: Jesus grew in wisdom as a man
9015.summary: Fully God yet fully man, Jesus grew in spirit and wisdom and had to learn the scriptures as we do, an example of hearing and committing God's word to heart.

9016.title: Jesus chose the Father's will at every step
9016.summary: As a man Jesus chose at every moment to do the Father's will rather than yield to the flesh, so that He could call us to do the same in His grace.

9017.title: Not cucked: Paul's subjection and boldness
9017.summary: Being subject to the powers, living peaceably and leaving vengeance to God is not weakness, for Paul and the apostles submitted while boldly preaching the truth even unto chains and death.

9068.title: God is able of these stones to raise children
9068.summary: John the Baptist rebuked the Jews for trusting their lineage from Abraham, repudiating the special treatment for the Jews that dispensationalists still teach.

9070.title: Son of David and Son of God
9070.summary: Luke's genealogy places Jesus in David's line as the promised King while He is also the Son of God, the two sonships of one who is fully God and fully man.

9083.title: What shall we do: fruits meet for repentance
9083.summary: John's answers to the people, publicans and soldiers show how the saved live out love thy neighbour: be honest, do not defraud or abuse your position, and be a light at work and home.

9100.theme: The old man and the new
9100.title: It is written: resisting the devil by the word
9100.summary: Jesus overcame Satan's temptations not by His divine nature but by clinging to every word of God, the pattern for how we resist temptation.

9101.theme: The old man and the new
9101.title: Turning to scripture to resist the devil
9101.summary: Just as Jesus resisted Satan with scripture and trusted the Father to provide, we can resist any temptation when we turn to God and stay in His word.

9102.title: Daily bread: prayer and the word against temptation
9102.summary: A daily walk of prayer and Bible reading feeds the new man and keeps Satan at bay, while neglecting them leaves us without the means of escape God has given.

9103.title: True fasting and prayer, not to be seen of men
9103.summary: Jesus prepared with real fasting and prayer to God, while those who deny every word of God and pray to men cannot resist temptation and fast to be seen of men.

9104.theme: Every word of God is pure
9104.title: Man lives by every word of God
9104.summary: All scripture is given by inspiration and is the only and final authority, sufficient for doctrine, as Jesus showed against Satan in the desert.

9125.title: As His custom was: Jesus went to church
9125.summary: Jesus' custom was to attend the synagogue, the local assembly of His day, even with imperfect preachers and congregations, so we should make going to church our routine.

9126.title: This day is this scripture fulfilled
9126.summary: Reading Isaiah 61 at Nazareth Jesus openly declared Himself the Christ, and when His own rejected Him He pointed to the Gentile widow and Naaman, prefiguring God's turn to the Gentiles.

9168.title: The leper's cleansing birds a picture of Christ
9168.summary: The Leviticus 14 ritual for a cleansed leper, with the slain bird in an earthen vessel and the living bird released, is a detailed picture of Christ's death and resurrection.

9174.title: When ye fast, not as the hypocrites
9174.summary: Jesus came to call sinners, not the self-righteous Pharisees who boasted of fasting and tithes; fasting is not a sign of righteousness but a seeking of God in times of trouble.

9176.title: New wine in new bottles: a better covenant
9176.summary: The parables of the new patch and new wine show Jesus was not mending the old covenant but replacing it with a better one, the replacement theology Zionists deny.

9190.title: Ordinances were pictures, not idols
9190.summary: The Old Testament ordinances like the sabbath were shadows of Christ ended at the cross, but the Pharisees, like Israel with the brazen serpent, made the picture an idol and a work of self-righteousness.

9192.title: Baptism and the Lord's supper are pictures
9192.summary: Baptism and the Lord's supper are the two New Testament ordinances, pictures of Christ that hold no saving power, and turning them or the sabbath into works for salvation is damnable heresy.

9194.title: Making a physical idol of spiritual pictures
9194.summary: False teachers take parables and pictures literally out of context and build doctrines of devils on them, such as infant sprinkling, sacramental bread and wine and praying to saints.

9208.title: Blessed are ye poor; rejoice when persecuted
9208.summary: Jesus told His disciples, unlike the fickle crowds seeking healing, that the poor and hungry who follow Him are blessed and should rejoice when persecuted for His name.

9209.title: Love your enemies, in context
9209.summary: After hard preaching against the crowds, Jesus told His disciples to love their enemies and judge not, meaning to show the mercy God showed us, not to ignore evil.

9211.title: Of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh
9211.summary: A tree is known by its fruit, and what we say and do reveals whether our hearts treasure God's grace or our grudges and envy.

9212.title: Built on the rock: doers of His sayings
9212.summary: Those who hear Jesus' sayings and do them build on a rock and will not be moved, while hearers only build on sand.

9227.title: The centurion's faith a model for ours
9227.summary: The centurion's great faith came with humility and love for others, a model for us to grow our faith by caring for those sick in spirit.

9228.title: Pure religion: compassion for the brokenhearted
9228.summary: Jesus raising the widow's son shows His compassion, and our mission like His in Isaiah 61 is to comfort the brokenhearted and visit the fatherless and widows.

9229.title: Blessed is he not offended in me
9229.summary: John's doubt was answered by the works Jesus did, showing it is fine to seek confirmation of our hope but we must believe the report and not be ashamed of the gospel.

9230.title: The people justified God, being baptized
9230.summary: Those who were baptized justified God, vindicating His word by an outward sign of faith, while the Pharisees showed their unbelief by refusing; baptism itself does not save.

9247.title: Wisdom is justified of all her children
9247.summary: Jesus likened the Pharisees to petulant children at play, and their worldly wisdom was shown by its fruit, people unable to come to the truth.

9249.title: Thy faith hath saved thee: a proof text
9249.summary: Jesus' own words to the sinful woman prove salvation by faith alone, her love following her forgiveness, while the self-righteous Pharisee could not be saved.

9251.title: Penance is an affront to the gospel of grace
9251.summary: Lenten penance contradicts salvation by grace and the finished work of Christ; fasting is to grow in God's will, not to pay for sins Jesus already paid.

9253.title: Is this the fast that I have chosen
9253.summary: In Isaiah 58 God condemns self-afflicting fasts done for strife and show, and says the fast He chose is to loose bands of wickedness and do works of mercy, the sabbath being rest that pictures Christ.

9256.title: Penance is not in scripture
9256.summary: The word penance is not in scripture, and the Catholic NAB inserts it into Isaiah 58:5, a passage where God calls such practices sin.

9271.title: Women who ministered with Christ
9271.summary: Men and women are equal in Christ with distinct roles, women serving greatly in the ministry while subject to their own fathers and husbands, and godly women follow when men fill their biblical roles.

9273.title: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear
9273.summary: Having ears to hear means choosing to be fertile ground, doers of the word who live out the Isaiah 61 mission rather than letting cares of the world choke the seed.

9286.title: Do we do all we can to heal the spiritually sick
9286.summary: The sign gifts ceased with completed scripture and modern faith healers are grifters, but the Spirit is upon us to preach the gospel, heal the brokenhearted and free the captive, and most of us hardly try.

9309.theme: Christ the foundation of the church
9309.title: Upon this rock: Christ, not Peter
9309.summary: The rock the church is built on is the truth that Jesus is the Christ, not Peter as Rome claims, and taking up the cross was a literal call for the apostles.

9310.title: Some shall not taste death: the transfiguration
9310.summary: Jesus' saying that some would see the kingdom was fulfilled eight days later at the transfiguration, so lifting it out of context to support preterism is a failure to rightly divide.

9313.title: This kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting
9313.summary: The disciples failed for unbelief, and Jesus shows that faith to overcome is grown by prayer and fasting, as He Himself did before every undertaking.

9314.title: Jesus felt the weight of time
9314.summary: The eternal Son, existing outside time, took on flesh bound by time, and that constraint was part of what He suffered as our Saviour.

9333.title: Sent two by two into the harvest
9333.summary: The sending of the seventy gives the pattern of evangelism, going two by two trusting God to provide, and we should rejoice most that our names are in the Kingdom.

9334.title: Be wise, win souls
9334.summary: Every saved person is called to the great commission, and as we grow in the word the call to share the gospel becomes hard to resist, so seek out soul winning churches.

9335.title: Pray the Lord of the harvest for labourers
9335.summary: Jesus commands us to pray for labourers in the harvest, so even if we do not go soul winning we must pray for those who do and to become one.

9385.title: Pray directly to the Father: one mediator
9385.summary: Jesus taught and lived the pattern of prayer: often, privately and earnestly to the Father in His name through the Spirit, with no intermediary like dead saints or a mediatrix.

9437.title: The red letters are the scriptures
9437.summary: Saying we should focus only on the red letters is a natural man's error, since Jesus is the Word and His sayings are the fulfilment of all scripture and its doctrine.

9458.title: Strait is the gate, not difficult
9458.summary: The strait gate is the one narrow way through Christ, and modern versions that make it difficult teach a hard salvation of works.

9459.title: Your house is left unto you desolate
9459.summary: Jesus' lament over Jerusalem which killed the prophets marks His being through with those reprobates, who would not see Him until the day of wrath.

9469.title: Workers of Heaven, not working for Heaven
9469.summary: Against the Pharisees' hypocrisy, we are not working for Heaven but are workers of Heaven, bought with a price to do charity and preach the gospel as in Isaiah 61.

9476.title: Eating in His presence is not believing on Him
9476.summary: Proximity to Christ, church attendance, family or works done in His name cannot save; only faith alone receives His imputed righteousness, as the wedding parables teach.

9477.title: Sit in the lowest room; call the poor to the feast
9477.summary: Jesus taught guests to seek the lowest seat and hosts to invite the poor who cannot repay, a pattern of the Kingdom, while the invited Jews who refused would not taste His supper.

9487.title: Take up the cross: the call of discipleship
9487.summary: Beyond salvation, discipleship means being willing to forsake family, possessions and life itself for Christ, a cost Jesus increasingly preached as the cross neared.

9488.title: Count the cost; salt that loses savour
9488.summary: Jesus urged the crowds to count the cost before following Him, for a disciple who falls away is mocked and like salt without savour is cast out.

9490.title: Discipleship, not salvation: count the cost
9490.summary: The hard sayings on discipleship are not about salvation, which is by grace, nor are they automatically true of every believer; forsaking all for Christ is a serious calling every saved person must weigh.

9505.title: We are the elder son
9505.summary: The prodigal son parable is addressed to the Pharisees as the resentful elder son, and many long-saved Christians likewise despise new converts and add works to the gospel of grace.

9506.title: Correct in love, rejoice over the lost
9506.summary: As God removes our sins as far as the east from the west, we must correct in love, forgive and forget, and rejoice when the lost return, without compromising on sin.

9522.title: Make friends of the mammon of unrighteousness
9522.summary: The unjust steward shows that worldly men use money wisely for the future, so Christians should use their wealth to bless others and lay up treasure in Heaven, for we cannot serve God and Mammon.

9523.title: Ye cannot serve God and Mammon
9523.summary: There is no prosperity gospel; part of the cost of discipleship is giving of our wealth without fear or greed, laying up treasure in Heaven.

9524.title: Willing to die but not to be inconvenienced
9524.summary: Christians who claim they would die for Christ will not give a little time to Bible reading, church or soul winning, so we must honestly count the cost and strive to do more.

9525.title: Jesus isn't Joel Osteen
9525.summary: Jesus preached no gospel of comfort and wealth, and the more we read the Bible the more we see what is required of us before we grow comfortable in our salvation.

9554.title: Live peaceably, then call out evil
9554.summary: By living peaceably, blamelessly and charitably and sharing what we have, we earn the respect that lets us stand for biblical truth and call out evil.

9563.title: Ye are they which justify yourselves before men
9563.summary: The covetous Pharisees derided Jesus because they justified themselves by works before men, missing that the law and prophets were given to bring them to salvation in Christ.

9564.title: Neither will they be persuaded, though one rose
9564.summary: In the rich man and Lazarus, those who will not hear Moses and the prophets would not believe even if one rose from the dead, as the hardened Jews proved.

9565.title: Heaven and Hell are real: the rich man and Lazarus
9565.summary: Jesus' parables are built on real things, so the rich man and Lazarus shows Heaven and Hell are real, while Abraham's bosom as a waiting compartment is a dispensationalist error.

9594.title: Woe to him through whom offences come
9594.summary: Mature believers must not offend babes in Christ by pride dressed as rebuke, and we must honestly own the times we caused others to stumble.

9595.title: The one leper who returned to give thanks
9595.summary: All ten lepers were healed as all believers are saved, but only one returned to give thanks, a picture of the few who go beyond bare minimum Christianity.

9596.title: We are unprofitable servants: how faith grows
9596.summary: Jesus answered how to grow faith by teaching that doing our duty only makes us unprofitable servants, so faith grows when in humble gratitude we do more.

9597.title: The one or the nine: bare minimum Christians
9597.summary: We must ask whether we are like the thankful Samaritan or the nine bare minimum Christians, and not judge others when we fall short ourselves.

9627.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
9627.title: As the lightning: no secret coming of Christ
9627.summary: Christ's return will be seen by all like lightning, with the saints gathered as Noah and Lot were taken before destruction, so the pre-trib secret rapture is a deception.

9628.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
9628.title: The resurrection is not past already
9628.summary: The rapture and resurrection of 1 Thessalonians 4 are still to come, and those who deny it or say it is past are like Hymenaeus and Philetus overthrowing the faith.

9629.title: Shall not God avenge His own elect
9629.summary: The parable of the unjust judge teaches us to pray always for the kingdom to come and for God's swift vengeance and wrath on the wicked.

9702.theme: The church is the Israel of God
9702.title: The vineyard given to others
9702.summary: In the parable of the husbandmen God takes the vineyard of His covenant from the unfruitful Jewish leaders and gives it to others, the replacement theology found throughout the Bible.

9712.title: Live blamelessly; be persecuted for His name
9712.summary: Unlike partisan cries of hypocrisy, Jesus lived blamelessly so He was persecuted only for righteousness, and we must avoid sinful rage so that persecution glorifies God.

9713.title: Their provocations bless you with separation
9713.summary: Woke provocations mostly ruin worldly things we should not consume anyway, so being shut out of them is God's blessing of separation, bringing us out of Sodom.

9726.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
9726.title: Lift up your heads: signs before His coming
9726.summary: Jesus' Luke 21 prophecy gives signs, persecution of believers and Jerusalem's desolation before He comes in the clouds to gather the saved, while woe comes on the Jews.

9728.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
9728.title: Not imminent: the signs before His return
9728.summary: The thief in the night is for the unprepared; Christ gave signs to watch, the seals and great tribulation, before His coming gathers the elect and the wrath begins, so imminence and pre-trib are deceptions.

9753.title: The passover lamb and the Lord's supper
9753.summary: The Passover ordinance pictured Christ the Lamb, and at His last supper Jesus turned it into a new memorial ordinance, the Lord's supper, done in remembrance of Him.

9754.title: The Lord's supper is a memorial, not a sacrament
9754.summary: The Lord's supper continues the Passover as a yearly memorial for saved church members with unleavened bread and unfermented juice, not a sacrament, not wine and not literal flesh as Rome teaches.

9782.title: Jesus' torment in Hell for our sins
9782.summary: Jesus spent the days after the cross in Hell bearing the sins of the world as the propitiation, which few Christians care to reflect on.

9803.title: Jehovahjireh: the Lord will provide
9803.summary: Abraham's offering of Isaac on Moriah, with the ram provided in his place, pictures God providing His only begotten Son as the sacrifice for sin.

9804.title: His blood be on us: the Jews crucified Christ
9804.summary: The Gospels show the Jews, not the Romans, demanded Christ's death, and Jesus prophesied judgment on them as the old covenant was done away at the cross.

9805.title: Today shalt thou be with me in paradise
9805.summary: The thief on the cross shows salvation by faith alone, and Christ's promise of paradise shows He is God in heaven, not that He skipped Hell for a waiting room.

9823.title: The Harrowing of Hell is a Catholic fable
9823.summary: The Catholic Harrowing of Hell misuses 1 Peter 4:6, which in context means the dead in Hell were shown their disobedience by Christ's resurrection, as those mocking Noah were destroyed in the flood.

9864.title: The more they afflicted them, the more they grew
9864.summary: Christians should welcome persecution and trials, because God uses them to grow His people and increase His harvest.

9918.title: The fathers have eaten sour grapes
9918.summary: Ezekiel 18 teaches that God judges each man on earth by his own sins, so we cannot blame our troubles on our fathers but must walk righteously ourselves.

9945.title: Moses full of excuses
9945.summary: Like Moses we make excuses not to go and preach, but God promises to be with our mouth, and His anger is kindled against those who refuse.

9947.title: The Lord met him and sought to kill him
9947.summary: Moses' uncircumcised son shows that letting unsaved or carnal family hold us back from God's will makes us lukewarm and brings God's chastening.

9966.title: Let my people go worship
9966.summary: God led with letting His people worship, so Christians must make sure any persecution they suffer is for Christ's name, not for being riotous or rendering evil for evil.

9969.title: A sweet savour of Christ
9969.summary: We should not care how we look to the world, since to the perishing we are the savour of death, but our obedience is a sweet savour to God and all things work together for good.

10045.title: Pharaoh a picture of the reprobate
10045.summary: Pharaoh's hardened heart pictures the reprobate and the Jews who deny Christ and forbid the gospel, who are given over to God's wrath to their destruction.

10063.title: The Lord doth put a difference
10063.summary: The final plague shows reprobation is real and final, while the meek in Christ will inherit the earth as Israel spoiled Egypt.

10080.theme: The old man and the new
10080.title: We melt down the treasure God provided
10080.summary: Like Israel turning Egypt's gold into the calf, saved Christians who forget the bondage God freed them from turn their blessings into idols and excuses to sin.

10082.title: Climbing out of the hole sin dug
10082.summary: Being saved does not remove every consequence of past sin; God gives the rope and light to climb out, and chastens those who despise it and backslide.

10091.theme: The old man and the new
10091.title: Lest the people repent when they see war
10091.summary: God guides new believers away from the worst trials early, and remembering His strong arm keeps us from turning back to the bondage of Egypt, as the parable of the sower warns.

10127.title: God's if/then covenants with nations
10127.summary: God's covenants with nations are conditional, judging nations by their works while He judges individuals by faith, and a nation that turns from wickedness can still be healed.

10149.title: Jesus the bread which came down from heaven
10149.summary: The manna in the wilderness pictures Christ the bread of life, and in John 6 the unbelieving Jews murmured and took His spiritual lesson literally.

10151.title: Thou hast the words of eternal life
10151.summary: Peter understood that Christ's words, not literal flesh and blood, give eternal life, so those who teach literally eating Christ's body for salvation are not saved, and John 6 does not teach Calvinism.

10159.title: Brethren who hold up our arms
10159.summary: As we leave sin, attacks and tribulation increase, but trusting God and letting fellow believers hold up our arms gives victory.

10179.title: Jethro's counsel to delegate judgment
10179.summary: God approves delegated authority, so believers should know His word for themselves, with fathers, pastors and deacons answering to Christ, a pattern of the Millennial kingdom.

10180.title: Honour to whom honour is due
10180.summary: We are to honour unsaved parents, husbands and rulers and live peaceably with all men by faith, without joining in their sin, rather than rebelling out of fear.

10196.theme: The church is the Israel of God
10196.title: If ye will obey, a peculiar treasure
10196.summary: The Sinai covenant was conditional and Israel broke it, so it was replaced by the new covenant and those saved in Christ are now God's peculiar people, refuting dispensational Zionism.

10205.title: The ten commandments covenant ended in Christ
10205.summary: The Sinai covenant of ten commandments ended in Christ, while its moral content remains in the two great commandments under the better testament.

10206.title: Thou shalt not bow down to graven images
10206.summary: Idolatry is still sin, and Catholic kneeling, candles and processions before images are worship of idols, a key reason God's wrath is on America and Europe.

10220.title: The judgments of God are ever relevant
10220.summary: Only the ceremonial law was done away in Christ, so Christians should learn the moral judgments of Exodus, which will be enforced in the Millennium where the saints judge.

10244.theme: The church is the Israel of God
10244.title: The entire Bible teaches one faith in Christ
10244.summary: What is mocked as replacement theology is simply the Bible's one theme of salvation in Christ from Moses to Revelation, which dispensationalism denies.

10245.title: Dispensationalism is wicked
10245.summary: Christians fall for dispensationalism by trusting study Bible notes and videos instead of reading the word, which teaches the law could not save and there is no other gospel for one people.

10247.title: Faith expected to grow
10247.summary: After salvation our faith should grow by believing a preserved Bible and its doctrine, avoiding the snares of false teachers and carnal readings of scripture.

10270.title: Blue, purple and scarlet
10270.summary: Every detail of the tabernacle, from its colours to the veil torn at Christ's death, points to Christ and is not irrelevant to the believer.

10307.title: Not a pattern for chapels and vestments
10307.summary: The tabernacle priesthood was a schoolmaster showing the failure of earthly rites, not a pattern for grand chapels, robed priests and vestments, since Christ offered one sacrifice for ever.

10311.title: The meaning of lead captivity captive
10311.summary: Judges 5 shows that to lead captivity captive means to defeat and take captive the one who would have made you captive, not to free captives.

10313.title: He led captivity captive
10313.summary: Ephesians 4 says Christ rose with the keys of death and Hell and so led captivity captive, and gives no hint of freeing saints from a holding room in Hell.

10328.title: The most complete ritual religion ever given
10328.summary: The priestly ordinances were God giving Israel the most perfect outward ritual religion, holy yet still worldly compared to the spirit of the New Testament, as a schoolmaster.

10332.title: God desired not sacrifice
10332.summary: The carnal ordinances show the futility of trusting priests and sacraments, since God desires mercy and a contrite heart and only faith in Christ's blood remits sin.

10340.title: The half shekel ransom for souls
10340.summary: The equal half shekel atonement paid by rich and poor was a memorial pointing to Christ, the ransom price paid for all our souls.

10361.theme: The old man and the new
10361.title: Who is on the Lord's side
10361.summary: At the golden calf some never truly believed, some like Aaron backslid, and a remnant stood with God, so we should not be cocky but fear God's scourging of His sons.

10370.title: My presence shall go with thee
10370.summary: The angel and presence that went before Israel was Christ, the way we can come to the glory of God without being consumed.

10381.title: There is one gospel
10381.summary: Galatians was written against Judaizers who demanded the law and slandered Paul, and the same attacks on Paul recur today, but anyone bringing another gospel is accursed.

10409.title: The Lord, merciful and gracious, and Jealous
10409.summary: In Exodus 34 God reveals Himself as merciful yet not clearing the guilty and as Jealous, guarding His people, while the feasts all picture Christ.

10410.title: Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk
10410.summary: The command not to seethe a kid in its mother's milk does not ban mixing meat and dairy, and kosher rules are vain traditions while the dietary laws are done away for Christians.

10411.title: Moses' face shone
10411.summary: Time with the Lord changed Moses so His glory shone, and Christians who walk in the Spirit reflect God's glory and must not hide their light though the world hates it.

10424.title: The sabbath and the free will offering
10424.summary: The sabbath pictured salvation by faith alone, so working on it meant trusting one's own works, and the free will offering pictures coming to Christ of our own free will.

10435.title: We are the tabernacle
10435.summary: In Christ we are the temple, and the works we build on Christ's foundation will be tried by fire, with gold, silver and precious stones rewarded.

10436.title: Nothing replaces your own reading
10436.summary: No commentary, sermon or post replaces reading the whole word yourself and letting the Spirit give wisdom for when God calls you to serve.

10455.title: Critical text claims are satanic foolishness
10455.summary: Modern critical text claims built on Vaticanus and Sinaiticus deny God's preservation of His word, choosing two corrupt manuscripts over thousands in agreement.

10463.title: The women's looking glasses for the laver
10463.summary: The women giving their mirrors for the laver pictures turning from vanity and self to service, being sanctified as doers of the word.

10477.title: Jesus will judge every man by his works
10477.summary: Christ will judge all by their works, the dead unto the lake of fire and the saved not for justification but for rewards in the kingdom.

10525.title: Created for His pleasure
10525.summary: As Christ, equal with God, submitted to the Father and was exalted, we must submit to God's will and to earthly order for His pleasure.

10526.title: Doing the will of God from the heart
10526.summary: All submission, of husbands, wives, children, servants and citizens, is ultimately submission to Christ, as Christ submitted to the Father.

10527.title: Not what is in it for me
10527.summary: Christians should stop doing the bare minimum and instead serve God gladly in every part of life, because it pleases Him.

10535.title: Josiah removed the sodomites
10535.summary: Good kings like Josiah tore down idols and removed the sodomites to win reprieve for the nation, so Christians must stand firmly against sodomites and evil.

10559.title: Benjamin protected the sodomites
10559.summary: Judges 19-21 shows God commanding war on Benjamin for protecting sodomites, a picture of our days when every man does what is right in his own eyes.

10615.title: Worse than thy sister Sodom
10615.summary: God was more offended by Judah's spiritual whoredom than by Sodom, so His greatest wrath is for apostate churches like Rome and the Orthodox, more than for sodomites.

10667.title: The epistles are written to the saved
10667.summary: Paul writes as one saved to fellow saints, so the epistles are to the saved, and false churches that call assurance the sin of presumption have another gospel.

10668.title: The righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith
10668.summary: When believers share the gospel, God reveals His righteousness through them, an awesome responsibility for every saved Christian.

10676.title: The wrath of God revealed from heaven
10676.summary: God reveals His wrath through creation and conscience so all are without excuse, and those who hold the truth in unrighteousness and worship the creature have their hearts darkened.

10719.title: Thou that judgest doest the same things
10719.summary: All, Jew or Gentile, are judged by the same law, so saved Christians must not judge hypocritically but be patient with new believers, knowing only grace spares them.

10721.title: There is no respect of persons with God
10721.summary: Jew and Gentile face the same judgment and revelation, refuting the dispensational idea that Jews are favoured by God.

10736.title: Let God be true, but every man a liar
10736.summary: The Jews' advantage of the oracles did not save them, unbelief does not void God's faithfulness, grace is no license to sin, and all are under sin.

10744.title: The gospel of grace in every age
10744.summary: God's grace through faith was given in every age from Adam and preached by the prophets, and the Judaizers' works gospel persecuted it.

10745.title: Works religion as power over men
10745.summary: Works-based religion gives leaders power over a fearful people, which is why the gospel of grace was persecuted then and is opposed by Rome and Lordshippers today.

10746.title: Good person, mass and purgatory cope
10746.summary: Those trusting works claim to be good people yet call assurance presumption and invent purgatory, because they will not admit they are sinners deserving Hell.

10747.title: Their throat is an open sepulchre
10747.summary: Romans 3 and Psalm 14 show that none is righteous and that false teachers, like the Pharisees, devour people with a deadly false gospel.

10750.title: Justified by faith without the deeds of the law
10750.summary: The law shows all guilty so no flesh is justified by works, but God's righteousness is given freely by faith in Christ's propitiation, which establishes the law.

10778.title: Abraham believed God
10778.summary: Abraham was counted righteous by believing, since works would make salvation a debt owed rather than grace.

10779.title: Justified before God and before men
10779.summary: Paul speaks of justification before God by faith and James of justification before men by works, so there is no contradiction and James 2 does not teach a works gospel.

10780.title: To him that worketh not
10780.summary: Anyone who makes salvation or keeping it depend on works claims God owes them and lacks the faith without which it is impossible to please God.

10784.title: Abraham the father of us all
10784.summary: The law works wrath, so the promise comes by faith through grace, making Abraham the father of all who believe, and the Jew has no claim to him outside faith.

10790.title: Therefore being justified by faith
10790.summary: Justified by faith we have peace with God now and stand in grace, and even glory in tribulations that work patience, experience and hope.

10791.title: While we were yet sinners
10791.summary: God showed His love by Christ dying for His enemies, so much more shall the reconciled be saved by His life and spared wrath.

10792.title: By one man sin entered
10792.summary: Adam's one sin brought death, not an inherited original sin, the law came to show sin abounding, and by one man Christ grace abounds to all who believe.

10793.title: The atonement in Romans 5
10793.summary: Romans 5 refutes those who deny vicarious atonement, showing Christ's blood reconciles sinners and His righteousness is imputed as a free gift.

10802.theme: The old man and the new
10802.title: Shall we continue in sin
10802.summary: Grace is no license to sin; baptism pictures our death with Christ so we should walk in newness of life, though holiness is not automatic as Lordshippers imply.

10803.title: The wages of sin and the gift of God
10803.summary: Eternal life is a gift not a wage, and the saved, made servants of righteousness, earn rewards judged by fire at the judgment seat while never losing salvation.

10822.theme: The old man and the new
10822.title: The spirit willing but the flesh weak
10822.summary: Saved Christians are dead to the law in the spirit, but the old man still reigns in the flesh, so we do what we would not until the redemption of the body.

10823.theme: The old man and the new
10823.title: We sin every day
10823.summary: Sinless perfection is impossible in the flesh, but walking in the Spirit through prayer, scripture, church and soul winning makes the flesh easier to mortify.

10824.theme: The old man and the new
10824.title: Our sanctification is not about salvation
10824.summary: Walking in the Spirit reveals more sin and gives grace to escape it, a refining that makes us useful vessels, not a means of salvation.

10825.title: O wretched man that I am
10825.summary: False prophets use Romans 7 to teach repent-of-your-sins works salvation or sinless living, but they deceive themselves and produce only fruit-inspecting hypocrites.

10828.theme: The old man and the new
10828.title: The fruits of the Spirit are not automatic
10828.summary: Even Paul struggled with sin, so good works and victory over sin are a daily choice to walk in the Spirit, and when we fall we confess and are forgiven.

10835.title: The earnest of our inheritance
10835.summary: The Holy Spirit is God's earnest, sealing believers as His purchased possession until the redemption of the body.

10836.title: The Spirit beareth witness
10836.summary: The Spirit witnesses that we are children and joint heirs, so even when the flesh fails we know our eternal state and should rejoice rather than despair.

10837.title: The Spirit maketh intercession for us
10837.summary: While we groan awaiting redemption, the indwelling Spirit helps our infirmities and intercedes for us according to the will of God.

10839.title: All things work together for good
10839.summary: God who spared not His Son will give us all we need, so all things, even tribulation, work for good and we should not worry over money, politics or persecution.

10840.title: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ
10840.summary: No one can lay a charge against God's elect or take away their salvation, because the indwelling Spirit assures eternal security.

10857.theme: The church is the Israel of God
10857.title: The children of the flesh are not the children of God
10857.summary: Romans 9 shows Israel after the flesh is cut off and the election is of the seed, Christ, not individual Calvinist election, and God has mercy on whom He will.

10858.theme: The church is the Israel of God
10858.title: All Israel saved in Christ
10858.summary: Unbelieving Jews were made reprobate like Pharaoh while a believing remnant remains, since all God's promises are kept in Christ the one seed.

10860.title: Hath not the potter power over the clay
10860.summary: God's predestination is the election of believers in Christ, not choosing who believes, and He may use vessels of wrath for His glory.

10861.title: They stumbled at that stumblingstone
10861.summary: Gentiles attained righteousness by faith while Israel failed by seeking it through works, which is Paul's argument in Romans 9, not Calvinism.

10872.title: A zeal of God, but not according to knowledge
10872.summary: Like Israel, zealous Catholics, Orthodox, Lordshippers and repent-of-sins preachers set up their own righteousness, but Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to believers.

10873.title: The word is nigh thee
10873.summary: Salvation is simply confessing Jesus as Lord and believing God raised Him, with no works or sacraments, so we must preach it.

10874.theme: Sowing the seed of the word
10874.title: Faith cometh by hearing the word
10874.summary: Winning souls is the work of eternal value, and the power to save is in the preached word of God, not our arguments or tracts.

10887.theme: The church is the Israel of God
10887.title: A remnant according to the election of grace
10887.summary: Romans 11 does not make unbelieving Jews God's chosen; only a remnant elected by grace through faith is saved while the rest are blinded.

10888.title: Let their eyes be darkened
10888.summary: The prophets and Jesus cursed unbelieving Israel, and bless them that bless thee is fulfilled in Christ, not in anyone calling himself a Jew.

10890.theme: The church is the Israel of God
10890.title: Boast not against the branches
10890.summary: The Gentiles are grafted into the root by grace, so they must not boast but fear, since God who cut off the natural branches could cut them off too.

10891.theme: The church is the Israel of God
10891.title: Until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in
10891.summary: Being grafted in is conditional on faith, and the fulness of the Gentiles simply means the harvest, when the Lord reaps at His coming before the wrath.

10897.title: Present your bodies a living sacrifice
10897.summary: Doctrine must be applied by presenting ourselves holy in service, not conformed to the world, each using his gifts to edify the one body.

10898.title: Let love be without dissimulation
10898.summary: True love is honest and must hate evil, so the world's tolerant, manipulative love and the sodomites' love is love slogan are evil called good.

10905.title: Not slothful in business
10905.summary: Freed from death we serve life by loving the brethren and working diligently for any boss as unto the Lord, laying up treasure in heaven.

10906.title: Rejoicing in hope, patient in tribulation
10906.summary: Christians should be cheerful in hope, patient in trouble and constant in prayer, as Paul and Silas singing in prison won the Philippian jailer.

10907.title: Bless them which persecute you
10907.summary: Be generous and hospitable and bless persecutors, trusting God to repay and to crush our enemies, which is pure religion.

10908.title: Mind not high things
10908.summary: Believers must be of one mind and humble, not wise in their own conceits like Calvinists and trad Catholics, patiently guiding those less mature.

10909.title: Condescend to men of low estate
10909.summary: Do not think yourself above the poor and broken, who are often most receptive to the gospel, remembering Christ humbled Himself for us.

10910.title: As much as lieth in you, live peaceably
10910.summary: Walking in the Spirit makes us generous, patient, just and peaceable and leaves vengeance to God, which is the fulfilling of the law.

10911.title: Heap coals of fire on his head
10911.summary: Doing good to enemies is strength, not weakness: it often turns enemies into friends, and it frustrates the wicked while God repays.

10965.title: Faithful over a few things
10965.summary: Freed from sin, we should live in love and service, because faithfulness with our talents now determines our rule in the Millennial kingdom.

10967.title: Learning to serve that we may rule
10967.summary: As heirs we learn to rule by serving, obeying parents, husbands loving and wives submitting, and obeying even wicked rulers while keeping God's word as final authority.

10968.title: The spirit of rebellion
10968.summary: Rebellion against God-ordained hierarchy is Satan's spirit, yet we never obey a command to sin, and like Paul and Silas our obedient behaviour can win our persecutors.

10969.title: Render to Caesar what is Caesar's
10969.summary: God uses the persecution of believers to convert even rulers, so paying taxes and suffering wrong is a trifle next to eternal treasure.

10970.title: God will repay those who persecute His saints
10970.summary: God promises vengeance on all who persecute His children, so believers are not doormats but rest in His deliverance and are not ashamed of the gospel.

10971.title: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers
10971.summary: God ordains the powers that be, even wicked rulers, so revolting against them is sin, and liberty comes from Christ rather than from a worship of freedom itself.

10973.title: Those offended by Romans 13 do not do the work
10973.summary: Those who call for insurrection instead of obeying Romans 13 show a lack of faith and neglect the real work God asks: the word, church, prayer and winning souls.

10974.title: Render tribute: not paying taxes is sin
10974.summary: Under Romans 13 refusing to pay taxes or obey the law on them is sin, and pastors who teach it are as harmful as false prophets.

10990.title: Receive the weak in faith, not to doubtful disputations
10990.summary: Romans 14 teaches believers not to judge or argue with brethren over matters scripture leaves open, but to bear with weaker consciences and not put stumbling blocks before them.

10991.title: Do not judge another man's servant
10991.summary: In matters of liberty such as holidays, both the stronger and the weaker believer must stop judging each other, since each gives account to God.

10992.title: Encourage, do not scorn, those weaker in the faith
10992.summary: Believers who take sanctification seriously should edify rather than scorn those who are weaker or fearful, speaking the truth in love and saving rebuke for clear doctrine.

11004.title: The strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak
11004.summary: Strong believers should put aside their own comfort to build up the weak, following Christ's example of meekness without compromising the truth.

11005.title: Written aforetime for our learning
11005.summary: Romans 15:4 shows that scripture is the means by which we learn God's doctrine and the source of our hope, meant to make believers likeminded.

11007.title: The alms for Jerusalem were for believing saints
11007.summary: The collection for the poor saints at Jerusalem was temporary relief for believing brethren in a famine, not a mandate for Christians to fund unbelieving Jews forever.

11019.title: There is no liberty outside of Christ
11019.summary: True liberty comes only from salvation in Christ, not from any constitution, and only God blesses a nation through those who keep the faith.

11048.title: The meat offering a picture of Christ
11048.summary: The unleavened, anointed meat offering pictures sinless Christ, and the salted firstfruits picture the saved, preserved by the Holy Spirit and spared the fire.

11049.title: The burnt offering: free will and substitution
11049.summary: The burnt offering was offered by a man's own voluntary will as a substitute for his sin, refuting Calvinism and the Orthodox and Catholic errors on atonement.

11076.title: The bloody sacrifices show the cost of sin
11076.summary: The gory sin offerings, slain by the sinner's own hand, showed Israel beforehand that the cost of sin is death, fire and blood, fulfilled in Christ's passion.

11083.title: Confession: admitting our sin before God
11083.summary: No one can be saved without confessing they are a sinner, and pride against confession is what drives people to works religion and false priestly confession.

11084.title: Confess your faults one to another
11084.summary: True confession to God and to brethren is a God-given bulwark against sin, while false confession that excuses sin or works it off as penance is wicked.

11096.title: Restitution, not prisons: God's just law
11096.summary: God's law of restitution for theft is just and perfect, and a nation living by His judgments would be better than man's criminal justice system.

11140.title: God's glory revealed in our salvation
11140.summary: God's glory is shown in salvation as a free gift of grace without works, so all who add works rob God of His glory.

11159.title: Nadab and Abihu offered strange fire
11159.summary: Nadab and Abihu died for adding their own works to God's commanded worship, the same error as those who follow traditions and church fathers over scripture.

11161.title: Aaron's grief and God's longsuffering
11161.summary: God is merciful and patient when grief leaves our heart unable to do His will that day, as long as we do not curse God or backslide.

11162.title: Kings and priests should not drink wine
11162.summary: Believers are a royal priesthood and princes, so like the priests and kings they should abstain from alcohol and be sober.

11182.title: The dietary laws a living parable of holiness
11182.summary: The clean and unclean food laws were a schoolmaster teaching holiness, done away in Christ, so we are holy by the heart and not by what we eat.

11183.title: Abstaining from meats: a sign of false religion
11183.summary: Imposing meat bans or Levitical dietary laws, whether Catholic or Judaizing, is a doctrine of devils and a red flag of a cult.

11239.title: How the fool, wise and righteous learn
11239.summary: The fool never learns, the wise learn from others, the righteous learn from God's word, while the wicked and hypocrites know right and abuse it.

11251.title: The cleansing of the leper points to Christ
11251.summary: The law for cleansing a cured leper, a seemingly impossible event, is full of pictures of Christ and served as a testimony that a prophet, the Son of God, was among them.

11289.title: Zeal of God, but not according to knowledge
11289.summary: Professing Christians who insist on being special, like the unbelieving Jews, go about to establish their own righteousness and become zealots for a works system.

11290.title: Wedding garment, not your own filthy rags
11290.summary: Like the guest who refused the provided wedding garment, those who come in their own righteousness instead of Christ's will be cast into outer darkness.

11308.title: The Romans Road gospel presentation
11308.summary: The Romans Road with John 3:16 uses scripture to explain simply that all have sinned, Christ died for us, and whosoever believes and calls on the Lord is saved.

11313.title: White-knuckle Christianity
11313.summary: Christians who try to change their lives alone, without a local church and real accountability, are set up to fail and are easily misled online.

11314.title: White-knuckle Christians carried away by strange doctrines
11314.summary: Believers outside a local church fall into strange doctrines, purity spirals and online crusades, seeking to establish their own righteousness.

11326.title: Telegram isn't church: the qualifications of a pastor
11326.summary: A pastor must meet 1 Timothy 3 and lead a real assembly, so online preachers who are brawlers and teach works salvation are not pastors.

11336.title: Faith in Christ the only religion that is not a cult
11336.summary: True faith is the only religion not held by coercion, since salvation is revealed and given at the start and everything after is by free will.

11344.title: The scapegoat and the sin offering
11344.summary: On the day of atonement the slain goat pictures Christ and the scapegoat the remission of sins carried away and remembered no more.

11359.title: The Lord's supper versus Catholic communion
11359.summary: Since God forbids eating blood and Jesus called the cup the fruit of the vine, the Lord's supper is a remembrance and the Catholic mass is a pagan perversion.

11372.title: Our nakedness is for our spouse
11372.summary: The Leviticus 18 prohibitions on uncovering nakedness predate Moses, still stand, and extend to pornography and all nudity outside marriage.

11373.title: Abortion: passing children through the fire
11373.summary: Abortion is today's child sacrifice to Molech and Mammon, and the women burdened by it should be reached with the gospel before their hearts are hardened.

11375.title: The land vomiteth out her inhabitants
11375.summary: God judges nations for sexual perversion, idolatry and child sacrifice, and only turning from these sins heals the land.

11393.title: Leave the gleanings for the poor and stranger
11393.summary: The gleaning law is God's way of caring for the poor, and spiritually our freely given bounty may bring the lost to the truth.

11394.title: Love thy neighbour came from Leviticus
11394.summary: The laws against lying, talebearing and partiality flesh out love of neighbour, a commandment from the same God who forbade sexual immorality, not something Jesus invented.

11398.title: Separation from heathen practices
11398.summary: God forbade pagan customs such as enchantment, pagan haircuts, cuttings and tattoos for the dead, and believers should not imitate the heathen.

11401.title: Lordship salvation is a false gospel
11401.summary: Requiring people to make Jesus Lord of their life or repent of their sins to be saved makes man his own savior and is another gospel.

11402.theme: The gospel that must be believed
11402.title: This is the gospel one must believe
11402.summary: The gospel to believe is Christ's death, burial and resurrection for our sins, as preached to the jailer and the eunuch, not a willingness to turn from sin.

11403.title: By their fruits: works-based false prophets
11403.summary: By their fruits ye shall know them is about false prophets, whose works-based gospel produces insecure, legalistic, hypocritical followers.

11404.theme: The gospel that must be believed
11404.title: What one must understand to be saved
11404.summary: To be saved one must believe he is a sinner deserving hell, that salvation is a free gift, that Jesus died and rose, and call upon Him, trusting nothing of himself.

11405.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
11405.title: Repentance is a change of heart, not works
11405.summary: Repentance is believing what we did not before, and the lost stumble at accepting salvation as a free gift sealed by the Spirit, which false prophets exploit.

11406.theme: Sowing the seed of the word
11406.title: Give the gospel from scripture, not rhetoric
11406.summary: Faith comes by hearing the word, so a true gospel presentation leads through scripture, while false prophets paraphrase to avoid being pinned down.

11407.theme: The gospel that must be believed
11407.title: Cornelius saved by believing before baptism
11407.summary: The thief on the cross and Cornelius were saved by believing on Christ, receiving the Holy Ghost before baptism and without turning from sin.

11410.theme: The gospel that must be believed
11410.title: Saved by confessing Jesus is the Christ
11410.summary: Paul, Peter, Andrew and Thomas were saved by believing Jesus is the Christ, while Judas, the one who repented himself of his sin, was lost.

11411.title: No one is saved by repent of your sins
11411.summary: A gospel of repenting of sins and making Jesus your boss saves no one, since we are saved only by believing on the Son.

11412.title: What must I do to be saved
11412.summary: Answering a seeker with repent of your sins instead of believe on the Lord Jesus Christ only leads to confusion, discouragement and perdition.

11416.title: The five fundamentals of the faith
11416.summary: The 1910 Presbyterian Doctrinal Deliverance set out the five fundamentals, inerrancy, virgin birth, atonement, bodily resurrection and miracles, the origin of the name fundamentalist.

11425.title: God's civil law still judges nations
11425.summary: The civil punishments of Leviticus 20, unlike the ceremonial ordinances, are God's standard for judging nations and remain in effect today.

11426.title: Cut off for Molech and familiar spirits
11426.summary: God commanded that those who gave children to Molech or went after mediums be cut off, showing His perfect will for a people seeking to be holy.

11427.title: The law failed because men failed
11427.summary: The law failed to produce righteousness because Israel would not execute its judgments, and God's wrath abides on any nation that refuses His statutes.

11428.theme: The old man and the new
11428.title: Liberty from sin to walk in the Spirit
11428.summary: Salvation by grace without works frees believers to be sanctified by the Spirit, which is why faithful Baptist churches bear the fruit of separated lives.

11429.title: Israel saved by the blood before the law
11429.summary: Israel was delivered from Egypt by faith in the passover blood before receiving the law, so those who demand turning from sin before believing reverse God's order.

11431.title: Abraham believed God and it was counted for righteousness
11431.summary: Abraham was saved by believing God before circumcision or law, and his offering of Isaac justified him only before men, so all the glory is God's.

11437.theme: Repentance is a change of mind
11437.title: Repentance is metanoia, not turning from sin
11437.summary: Repentance is a change of mind that brings discernment, and turning from sin follows only if the new man is fed, while the backslider is still saved.

11449.title: Let no man judge you in meat or holy days
11449.summary: Sanctification is not automatic or required for salvation, and believers must not be beguiled by philosophy, traditions or asceticism that pass for holiness.

11461.title: The priest and pastor husband of one wife
11461.summary: The holiness laws for Levitical priests mirror the qualifications of a pastor, and all believers as a holy priesthood should be separated in spirit.

11478.title: The sabbath rest and spring feasts picture Christ
11478.summary: The sabbath rest pictures salvation by Christ's finished work rather than ours, and the spring feasts were fulfilled in Christ's death, resurrection and Pentecost.

11480.title: Christ is found in every book
11480.summary: The ordinances show that God's word is consistent across thousands of years and many authors, with Christ as its single theme and the same faith in both testaments.

11498.title: The shewbread and the Lord of the sabbath
11498.summary: The lamps and shewbread picture God's truth and word, and religion that forgets their meaning becomes rote practice used to condemn, as with the Pharisees.

11499.title: Eye for eye is God's law, not Hammurabi's
11499.summary: Eye for eye is God's just law for magistrates, while Jesus calls believers personally to mercy, and the two are complementary rather than contradictory.

11501.title: Justice in the world, meekness in the believer
11501.summary: Believers must be meek peacemakers personally while God's law should still be upheld by the state, and ignoring this has left society with neither justice nor mercy.

11502.title: God's law is perfect, we are not
11502.summary: The tension between justice and mercy lies in us, since we want vengeance where God wants justice, and staying in the word makes His judgment clearer.

11512.title: The jubilee pictures Christ's redemption
11512.summary: The sabbatical years and jubilee picture Christ as near kinsman redeemer, with the trumpet of jubilee pointing to His second coming and our redemption.

11514.title: Woe to them that join house to house
11514.summary: God's jubilee law forbade usury and the hoarding of land, a fair system neither capitalist nor communist that kept families and tribes intact and still shows how to live.

11515.title: We are God's servants, bought with a price
11515.summary: The jubilee reminds us we are God's servants bought by Christ's blood, so we work honestly for others as working for Him and trust Him to provide.

11530.title: Romans 2 answers a rhetorical opponent
11530.summary: In Romans 2 Paul is not addressing Jews in the church but answering a rhetorical Jewish objector, part of one methodical argument across the epistle.

11544.theme: The church is the Israel of God
11544.title: The covenant kept in Christ, not in the Jews
11544.summary: Leviticus 26's remedy of confession is fulfilled in Christ, and God's Israel is believers circumcised in heart, while unbelieving Jews remain under the curse.

11546.title: God hates idols among His people
11546.summary: Idol worship by those claiming His name, such as Catholics and Orthodox, provokes God's wrath and is a leading reason for the curses on Europe and America.

11565.title: Christ our surety, the Spirit our earnest
11565.summary: The law of vows and surety pictures salvation, where Jesus is the surety of a better testament and the Spirit the earnest until the day of redemption.

11567.title: Swear not at all: let your yea be yea
11567.summary: Believers have no need to make vows, because an honest man keeps his word with a plain yes or no, fulfilling the spirit of the law.

11588.title: A Jew is defined by rejecting Christ
11588.summary: Modern Jews are defined by their rejection of Christ and are like a put-away unfaithful wife, while God has taken believers as His people.

11605.title: If my people which are called by my name
11605.summary: Nations are judged by the works of those who call themselves by God's name, and the promise of 2 Chronicles 7:14 extends to every nation with Christians in it.

11606.title: The Scofield Bible's heresies
11606.summary: The Scofield study Bible twisted scripture to teach Zionism, dispensationalism and the kingdom given to the Jews, and to accommodate false science.

11607.title: Scofield's gap theory from Jeremiah 4
11607.summary: Scofield invented the gap theory between Genesis 1:1 and 1:2 from Jeremiah 4, so if he added to the first verse, none of his notes should be trusted.

11641.title: God gives many chances, then judgment
11641.summary: God warns nations, backsliders and the lost again and again, but after rote religion and wickedness continue, His judgment comes and He forbids intercession.

11642.title: Obey my voice: the only dispensation is grace
11642.summary: God's command to Israel was to believe His voice and then walk in His ways, the one dispensation of grace through faith in every age.

11643.title: The temple and sacrifices could not save
11643.summary: The temple and sacrifices were a gift to those already justified by faith, not the means of it, as Abraham was saved before circumcision.

11644.title: Cakes to the queen of heaven
11644.summary: Jeremiah 7 condemns sacraments over faith and specifically the worship of the queen of heaven, which Catholic Bibles annotate away.

11654.title: Peace and safety, then sudden destruction
11654.summary: False prophets cry peace, but watchful believers know the signs and seasons, while the day of the Lord comes as a thief only on the unready.

11678.title: Learn not the way of the heathen
11678.summary: Astrology and idols are vanity and foolishness before the Creator, and the heathen worship created things rather than the living God.

11679.title: The Lord is the true and living God
11679.summary: The idols men make cannot save, but the Lord is the true, living and everlasting King whose wrath cleanses the land of them.

11681.title: Jeremiah 10 is not about Christmas trees
11681.summary: Jeremiah 10 condemns carved idols, not decorative trees, so believers may celebrate Christ's birth in good conscience and others should not judge them.

11712.theme: The church is the Israel of God
11712.title: Continuation theology, not replacement theology
11712.summary: Israel's broken branches and the grafting in of believers show one promise by grace through faith in the same Christ, which is why the cut-off hate us.

11739.title: Jeremiah teaches us to face a nation's judgment
11739.summary: Jeremiah and Lamentations prepare believers to be at peace when judgment falls on their nation, trusting God's perfect will and His promised deliverance.

11740.title: Fearful and angry all the time? Get right with God
11740.summary: A believer constantly fearful and wrathful needs to get right with God, since tribulation should work patience and bring peace through His word and prayer.

11741.title: Preach the gospel as the nation falls
11741.summary: Like Jeremiah getting people saved as Judah fell, we must win souls, knowing we will not reach enough to stop the coming wrath.

11751.title: Win souls, don't hide in a bunker
11751.summary: Christians in the collapsing West should not panic or flee to the hills but, like Jeremiah in Jerusalem, stay in their communities winning souls.

11782.title: Carry no burden on the sabbath
11782.summary: The command to carry no burden through the gates on the sabbath pictures salvation without works, the rest found in Christ.

11806.title: The potter's power over nations
11806.summary: The potter of Jeremiah 18 and Romans 9 is about nations, as God destroys some to show His wrath and His mercy on others, as with the Jews and Gentiles.

11808.title: Jeremiah's imprecatory prayer
11808.summary: We preach to all, but like Jeremiah we may pray God's wrath on those who utterly reject the truth and seek our lives.

11809.theme: The church is the Israel of God
11809.title: The righteous remnant and replacement theology
11809.summary: So-called replacement theology is God's will to show mercy on vessels prepared unto glory, always preserving a remnant saved by faith rather than works.

11854.title: God hates false prophets and filthy dreamers
11854.summary: God hates false teachers who bind burdens of works, claim dreams, or promise peace to idolaters, and they will hear depart from me at the White Throne.

11871.title: The good and evil figs
11871.summary: The good figs carried captive and the rotten figs left show both God's mercy and wrath, and believers planted in Christ cannot be plucked up.

11914.title: The wine cup of God's fury on all nations
11914.summary: God judges nations by their works while saving individuals by faith, and His fury poured on Judah and its neighbours foreshadows the judgment on end-times Babylon.

11915.title: End-times Babylon is not Jerusalem
11915.summary: Revelation 16 shows Jerusalem divided before Babylon is judged, so they are distinct, and the spirit of Babylon rests on America and the West.

11932.title: We have no excuse
11932.summary: Since we do not face death for preaching as the prophets did, we have no excuse not to serve, and should rejoice in tribulation.

11943.title: Filthy dreamers preaching good things
11943.summary: Like Jeremiah's false prophets, today's prophets of prosperity, a third temple and blessing the Jews keep men under false hope.

12004.theme: The new heavens and new earth
12004.title: The new Jerusalem in Jeremiah 31
12004.summary: Jeremiah 31 has a dual fulfilment: the return from Babylon and the new Jerusalem in Christ for scattered believers of all nations.

12013.theme: The church is the Israel of God
12013.title: Jeremiah's field: a pledge of redemption
12013.summary: Jeremiah's purchase of a field during the siege promised Judah's return and, in dual fulfilment, the everlasting covenant with the Israel of God saved by faith.

12014.title: Judgment on nations for innocent blood and idolatry
12014.summary: God pours out judgment on nations that shed innocent blood and on apostate churches, like Rome and her daughters, that commit idolatry in His name.

12030.title: The covenants of David and Jacob fulfilled in Christ
12030.summary: In promising to restore Jerusalem, God foretells Christ, in whom the covenants with David and the Levites are as sure as day and night.

12043.title: Judaizers bringing the free back into bondage
12043.summary: As Judah took back the servants they had freed, false teachers and works salvationists seek to bring those set at liberty in Christ back under the yoke of the law and the traditions of men.

12056.title: The Rechabites obeying their father
12056.summary: God blesses children who obey even their father's own rules, as the Rechabites did, and uses them to shame Judah's disobedience to her heavenly Father.

12090.title: The burned scroll written again
12090.summary: When Jehoiakim burned the scroll God had it written again, showing that His word cannot be destroyed though the false church has burned both manuscripts and the men who held them.

12091.title: Fasting and outward piety cannot save
12091.summary: Judah fasted while under God's judgment, but outward acts of piety cannot cover a sinful heart, as Jesus taught of the hypocrites and the Pharisee.

12092.title: Repentance from false beliefs about God
12092.summary: What people most often repent of is not their sins but their false beliefs about God, His judgment and their own righteousness, turning from dead works and believing the gospel.

12107.title: God's patience runs out
12107.summary: Men and nations who reject God's word and only cry out in calamity find that His longsuffering has an end, and even the backslidden saved can be chastened or taken home.

12109.title: Seek the Lord in good times, not only in trouble
12109.summary: Christians who turn to God only in trouble slide back in prosperity, so we should walk with Him in praise, prayer and His word when times are good.

12121.title: Speak boldly despite the fear of the Jews
12121.summary: Church leaders who silence preaching against sin and Zionism do so for fear of men, but believers who fear only God speak boldly and give the gospel to every creature.

12147.title: Fleeing back to Egypt in our own will
12147.summary: Ishmael's rebellion and Judah's flight to Egypt picture how taking matters into our own hands against God's will leads back into the bondage of sin.

12150.title: Just believe, but they had already chosen Egypt
12150.summary: God promised the remnant deliverance if they only believed and stayed, but like many who ask what to do to be saved, they had already decided on their own way.

12153.title: Itching ears in perilous times
12153.summary: In tribulation proud men with itching ears follow false teachers who cry peace, peace, as megachurch and television preachers lead people back to Egypt.

12154.title: Stones at Pharaoh's gate a picture of Christ's coming
12154.summary: Nebuchadnezzar's throne set on stones at Pharaoh's gate pictures Christ the King setting His throne on the lively stones of believers and destroying idols.

12165.title: The queen of heaven and Mary worship
12165.summary: The worship of the queen of heaven, in Judah and in Rome's Mary worship, crept in through women seeking spiritualism and men who allowed it rather than keep God's order.

12166.title: Mary as co-redeemer and the cult of the queen
12166.summary: Rome makes Mary a co-redeemer and mediatrix, no different from the Jews in Egypt who credited the queen of heaven, and such idolatry brings nations to destruction.

12213.title: Babylon's fall a picture of the end times
12213.summary: The prophecy of Babylon's fall carries dual imagery of the final destruction of the spirit of Babylon when Christ avenges the blood of the saints.

12226.theme: After the tribulation, before the wrath
12226.title: Jerusalem's fall a picture of the great tribulation
12226.summary: Zedekiah's fall pictures the end: the pillars and holy vessels taken are the saints broken in the great tribulation, a remnant brought out, and the King lifted up as Christ.

12228.title: The Jews have no role in end times prophecy
12228.summary: Jews have no role in the end times except destruction; the third temple is Christ and His body, and any rebuilt temple or sacrifices would be an abomination.

12233.title: Spiritual adultery provokes God's wrath
12233.summary: What most provokes God's wrath is the spiritual adultery of those calling themselves His who serve idols, like the scarlet and purple sects of our day.

12234.title: The woman taken in adultery and spiritual adultery
12234.summary: Jesus exposed the scribes' own adultery against God, and his go and sin no more is a call to repentance toward Christ, not to sinless perfection.

12247.title: Jerusalem's desolation and the day of the Lord
12247.summary: As God slew Jerusalem without pity, so in the day of the Lord none of the nations will escape His anger except His servants carried away to His kingdom.

12254.title: His mercies are new every morning
12254.summary: However low we are, Christ paid a far worse penalty, and in remembering that we hope in the Lord whose compassions are new every morning and who calls us back from backsliding.

12255.title: Christ pleads our cause; fear not
12255.summary: As Jeremiah cried out of the dungeon, believers in their lowest points call on the Lord, who says fear not, pleads our cause and assures our deliverance.

12265.title: Nations judged by works, individuals by faith
12265.summary: Edom and the nations were destroyed for their works, because God judges nations by their works even as He judges individuals by their faith.

12294.title: Dispensationalism in light of Romans
12294.summary: Romans 1 lays the foundation against reading Romans 11:26 as Zionism: the gospel of Christ was promised by all the prophets and the dispensation of grace has been in effect from the beginning.

12318.title: Abraham justified by faith, not circumcision
12318.summary: Abraham was counted righteous by faith before circumcision, so the promise comes by faith and fleshly Jews have no claim on the Abrahamic covenant apart from Christ.

12320.theme: The church is the Israel of God
12320.title: No replacement, only the covenant to all nations
12320.summary: Jew and Gentile alike are saved only by faith with imputed righteousness, so there is no replacement theology and no other dispensation, only the covenant to Abraham for all nations.

12325.title: Access by faith into this grace
12325.summary: We access God's grace, offered to all men, by faith as a free will choice, contrary to Calvinism, and salvation is a free gift without works.

12326.title: Justified by faith, offered to all men
12326.summary: No fair reading of Romans yields faith plus works or salvation only for a chosen few, because Paul plainly concludes justified by faith and to all men.

12331.title: The law annulled as by a husband's death
12331.summary: The law is the ministry of death made null by Christ's death as a marriage ends at a husband's death, so dispensationalists reviving it are like a widow taking her dead husband back.

12333.title: Joint heirs with Christ, not with Jews
12333.summary: Believers are adopted sons and joint heirs with Christ, while unbelieving Jews in the flesh cannot please God and have no claim to the promise.

12335.title: Nothing can separate us from the love of God
12335.summary: Once the Spirit seals the believer nothing can separate him from God, so once saved always saved is the truth of the gospel itself.

12336.title: Our blessed hope of everlasting life
12336.summary: Trusting the gospel includes trusting that faith gives everlasting life and the resurrection, and without that sure hope one does not truly believe.

12368.theme: The church is the Israel of God
12368.title: A remnant according to the election of grace
12368.summary: God has not cast away His people He foreknew, meaning the believing remnant like Paul and the seven thousand, chosen by grace and not works.

12369.theme: The church is the Israel of God
12369.title: They stumbled that the Gentiles be saved
12369.summary: Israel stumbled so that Gentiles could be saved and the Jews provoked to jealousy, all revealing God's glory through His mercy and wrath.

12370.theme: The church is the Israel of God
12370.title: Provoke to emulation and save some
12370.summary: Paul's wish is that by provoking his kinsmen to jealousy he might save some, conditions that dispensationalists twist into will and all.

12371.title: Broken off for unbelief, grafted in by faith
12371.summary: The unbelieving Jews are cast off and blinded, and are grafted in again only if they believe, while Gentiles who grow highminded can be cut off just the same.

12372.theme: The church is the Israel of God
12372.title: And so all Israel shall be saved
12372.summary: All Israel in Romans 11:26 is the true seed adopted by faith, saved through Christ the Deliverer, while partial blindness remains on fleshly Israel until His coming.

12373.title: Dispensationalism falls apart by comparing scripture
12373.summary: Dispensationalism survives only on proof texts stripped of context, and falls apart when scripture is compared with scripture.

12399.title: The camp of Israel laid out as a cross
12399.summary: The tribes camped around the tabernacle likely formed a cross facing east toward Judah, a picture of Christ the morning star.

12401.title: Balaam looked down on the cross
12401.summary: Balaam marveling at the tents of Israel was looking upon a camp laid out as a cross, since Numbers is full of pictures of Christ.

12405.title: Four standards and the pattern of heaven
12405.summary: The four camps may have borne the lion, ox, man and eagle of the cherubim around God's throne, picturing Christ after the heavenly pattern shown Moses.

12415.title: The redemption of the firstborn
12415.summary: The shekels paid for the firstborn beyond the number of Levites picture the price of our redemption, paid by Christ, God's firstborn Son.

12424.title: Every Levite given his charge
12424.summary: As each Levite family had its own charge, every believer has a calling to edify the church, never to be boasted of or coveted.

12432.title: Without the camp: uncleanness a picture of sin
12432.summary: Putting the unclean outside the camp pictures church discipline, putting sin out of our lives, and separation from the world.

12434.title: The ledger of sin paid by Christ
12434.summary: The law's recompense plus a fifth for every trespass shows we could never pay our debt to God, and our only hope is Christ's blood.

12435.title: Corban: tradition making God's word void
12435.summary: The Pharisees used Corban to escape supporting their parents, keeping the letter of the law to justify corruption against God's command.

12445.title: The law of jealousy
12445.summary: God's jealousy is holy, and the law of jealousy protected both spouses, discouraging unfaithfulness and false accusation alike.

12446.title: Hair length and the order of heads
12446.summary: In 1 Corinthians 11 the woman's covering is her long hair, as a man's long hair is a shame, under God's order of heads: Christ, the man, the woman.

12465.title: Vows to God are grave
12465.summary: Vows to God must be taken seriously and paid, as Ecclesiastes, Numbers and the death of Ananias and Sapphira show.

12467.title: The Lord bless thee and keep thee
12467.summary: God had the priests put His name on Israel in blessing, and as a priesthood of believers we should remind others that their blessings are from God.

12502.title: The Passover open to every stranger
12502.summary: The Passover pictures salvation in Christ offered to anyone, the unclean and the stranger alike, with those who refuse cut off, and after salvation we follow the Lord.

12503.title: Salvation first, then follow
12503.summary: Israel was saved by the Passover blood before the sea, the law and the journey, showing salvation comes first and following God after.

12519.title: Lusting after Egypt and despising the manna
12519.summary: Israel's lust for Egypt pictures Christians longing for old sins, so we must hunger for the manna of God's word and feed others with it.

12520.theme: The old man and the new
12520.title: Quail until it come out at your nostrils
12520.summary: When a backslider runs back to old sins God often gives him his fill until it is loathsome, chastening every son He receives.

12532.title: Miriam's sedition against the man of God
12532.summary: Numbers 12 is about sedition against the man God placed over His people, not about mixed marriage, though scripture still warns against marrying strangers.

12533.title: Let the Bible tell us what it is discussing
12533.summary: Secondary dogmas forced out of a text miss the point, for the Bible is clear on doctrine and given for winning souls, not winning fights online.

12544.title: The evil report against eternal security
12544.summary: Like the ten spies, those who deny eternal security spread fear and doubt, while Caleb's faith pictures trusting Christ's promise that none can pluck us from His hand.

12545.title: God does the work; we merely trust
